name: Best Buy
description: Best Buy is the largest US-focused consumer electronics retailer: it buys phones, laptops, TVs, appliances and games from vendors and resells them in about 1,068 stores and online, mostly in the US with a Canadian segment (8 percent of sales). Margins are thin (22.5 percent gross, 3.3 percent operating) because it sells other companies' products; it adds higher-margin income from services (Geek Squad, installation, memberships, warranties, health), its Best Buy Ads retail media business and a third-party Marketplace. FY2026 revenue was $41.7 billion (+0.4%), operating income $1.39 billion and net earnings $1.07 billion; computing and mobile phones is now 47 percent of domestic sales.
